name: Kishi Station Tama Cat Conductor
description: The famous countryside train station on the Wakayama Electric Railway, world-renowned for its feline Stationmasters (Tama II Nitama and Yontama) working inside a cat-shaped station building.
notes: Check cat stationmaster duty schedules online before visiting.
notesJa: 【見どころ】猫の顔の形をした駅舎と、三毛猫の「ニタマ駅長」が働く名物駅です。
reservationJa: 【予約】事前予約不要です（いちご電車やたま電車の乗車券が便利です）。
parking: No station parking; take Kishigawa Line train
parkingJa: 【駐車場】駅前駐車場無しため、和歌山駅から貴志川線電車利用を推奨。

editorial.editorialSummary: Famous railway station home to feline Stationmaster Nitama and cat station building.

en.name: Kishi Station Tama Cat Conductor
en.description: The famous countryside train station on the Wakayama Electric Railway, world-renowned for its feline Stationmasters (Tama II Nitama and Yontama) working inside a cat-shaped station building.

ja.name: 貴志駅・たま駅長
ja.description: 和歌山電鐵貴志川線の終着駅で、三毛猫が駅長を務めるユニークな人気スポットです。檜皮葺きの猫型駅舎にはたまカフェやたま神社が併設され、可愛らしい「たま電車」で訪れることができます。
highlights: たま電車・いちご電車
